raw_text:
PLAN "Prenatal Strength Maintenance - 12 Weeks (Gestational Weeks 20-32)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength safely through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Maintain (Gestational Weeks 20-23)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower and Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_abduction 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          suitcase_carry 3x30..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
